description: This file is a C header file defining interfaces for a plugin module related to MeshAgent. It includes function declarations for initialization, support checks, and unloading within a plugin architecture, and employs external linkage for C++ compatibility.

methods.name: COSA_Init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with a specified maximum version supported and plugin information handle.

methods.name: COSA_IsObjSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific object is supported by the plugin.

methods.name: COSA_Unload
methods.description: Unloads or cleans up the plugin.
